name: easyrender
tagline: Remote image-to-3D MCP: preview a product photo, then build a textured GLB with account credits
description: A hosted Streamable HTTP MCP at https://easyrender.ai/api/mcp. OAuth-capable clients can sign in at the endpoint. An optional API key can be supplied as a Bearer token. Tools cover preview, credit balance, and a paid textured GLB build. Not dimensionally accurate CAD, room reconstruction, or photogrammetry.

env.name: EASYRENDER_API_KEY
env.description: Optional API key as a Bearer token. OAuth-capable clients can sign in at the endpoint instead.
